CVE-2026-116587 affects applications that parse attacker-controlled RSA private keys from JWKs. SPIRE Server imports go-jose v3 only through its bundle formatter, which constructs public keys from internal SPIRE bundle data and serializes them to JWKS; it does not parse attacker-controlled JWKs.
